source: Rebuild of jesse.trade's premium AlligatorV2 by matching (checks/candidates/jesse_premium_rebuilds/PREREG.md): free AlligatorAi code + the settings that best reproduce the premium's published in-trade days. net = return per trade as a fraction of entry price after 0.05% fee + 0.02% slippage a side (target fills fee only)
note: t / tx = UTC open time of the 30m candle whose close is the entry / the candle in which the exit happened; one position at a time
